title: SegmentationOutputEnvelope
description: Canonical shared envelope for segmentation skill output payloads. Defines the minimum structural contract for nv_segment_ct-style output payloads. Skill-specific fields are permitted alongside these. See docs/spec-model.md for placement rationale.

invocation.description: Provenance of the underlying tool invocation (command, identity, exit status). Shape is skill-specific; segmentation skills guarantee this key is an object.

output.description: Structured summary of produced segmentation artefacts. Shape is skill-specific; segmentation skills guarantee this key is an object.

runtime.description: Wall-clock timing captured by the wrapper. Shape is skill-specific; segmentation skills guarantee this key is an object.

model_repo.description: Canonical model repository URL or identifier (nv_segment_ct only).

input.description: Summary of the input artefact passed to the skill (nv_segment_ct only).

intended_use_disclaimer.description: Free-text disclaimer asserting non-clinical scope (nv_segment_ct only).

logs.description: Optional stdout/stderr tails captured from a wrapped subprocess.
